normalization: Per-ROI F0 = 20th percentile of generated 8-frame average; shared F0 for raw40, average40, generated5. Archive uses its 20th percentile at the same averaged time scale. Delta F/F, no extra smoothing.
average40: 8-frame moving average, stride1, valid windows; generated5 is exactly every eighth average40 sample
lag: Full available lag in each condition; approximately the same physical span, maximum center lag199.775s raw and199.600s averaged
seed: same fixed seed for every condition; no network-driven tuning
independent_unit: one cell; ROI pairs are descriptive technical comparisons, not independent animals
baseline_sensitivity: Repeat source-derived conditions using raw40 20th percentile F0; keep archived primary preprocessing and report source-only comparisons separately
analysis_scope: One paired recording with author supplied structure masks; supports a technical case study, not population invariance
